d:
Diwali aur chai ke liye Aloo Ki Crispy Mathri — oven ya air fryer mein bina tale bhi!
Ek boond paani nahi — grated aloo se dough, baked aur fried dono ka test.
aalu ki krispi mathri ka sahi anupat: aalu, besan, chaval ka aata aur suji
bina pani ka aata, bina rest belna aur katna
ovan, eyar phrayar ya karhaee — bek banam phraee ka kranch test
Comment karein — aap Aloo Ki Mathri bake karenge ya fry?
